scenes.title: NOT A *PLAN*
scenes.sub: It's entertainment with a price tag

captions.t: If you bought ten Powerball tickets every single week… how long until you win the jackpot?
The odds of winning the Powerball jackpot are one in two hundred ninety-two million.
Ten tickets a week is five hundred twenty tickets a year.
On average, you'd need about five hundred sixty thousand years to hit it once.
That's longer than humans have existed. The lottery isn't a plan. It's entertainment… with a price tag.
Follow for more money math they don't tell you.
